ja: • 『機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN III 暁の蜂起』より、ザクのひな形となった機体「YMS-03 ヴァッフ」が早くもHG化！
• ザクの系譜を彷彿とさせる独特のフォルムに、付属のテトロンシールで劇中のマーキングも再現可能！
• 広い可動域で多彩なポージングができるほか、前腕部は「HG プロトタイプグフ（戦術実証機」や「HG モビルワーカーNW-01 01式後期型」との交換機構を有し、設定の深みとプレイバリューを両立！
• さらに、バズーカや専用シールド、ヒート・ホークといった各種武装も付属！
en: • From "Mobile Suit Gundam THE ORIGIN III: Dawn's Uprising", the Zaku model aircraft "YMS-03 Vaff" has already been made into HG!
• The unique form is reminiscent of the Zaku lineage, and the markings from the movie can be reproduced with the included Tetron Seal!

• In addition to a wide range of motion that allows for a variety of poses, the forearm has an exchange mechanism for the ``HG Prototype Gouf (Tactical Demonstrator) and HG Mobile Worker NW-01 Type 01 Late Model,'' achieving both depth of setting and play value!
• In addition, various weapons such as a bazooka, special seal, and heat hawk are also included!
